rows.grounds: compound adjective built from aihika, amuṣmika, jñāna, and mayī; analyzed as one fused token
compound adjective from sakala, siddhi, and dā; analyzed as one fused token

items.question: What quality of knowledge makes this teaching bestow every siddhi?
premises: Knowledge spans this world and the next.
items.inference: The verse identifies all-siddhi-bestowing knowledge as encompassing both worldly and otherworldly cognition.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic relation of mayī within the compound remains unresolved.
items.plain_english: It is full of knowledge of this world and the next, and it gives all siddhis.
